body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose a 2-unit line within 5 units. Compare this Action against each enemy in the line; on a success, move it 1 unit and make the line difficult terrain until your next turn.

surges.html: Choose one creature this Action succeeds against; make it Chilled or Corroded.
The difficult terrain created by this Action lasts through the end of your next turn.

rider.title: WATER THREAD
rider.html: After resolving this Action, create a Thread. Consume this Thread before resolving a future Magecraft Action to make one affected space difficult terrain until your next turn.
